scientific_limitations: The all-zero-set and sharp-radius parts are only for odd dimension. Even dimension only guarantees a smooth hypersurface zero stratum; no sharp even-dimensional radius is claimed. The result concerns equal masses on parity-selected sign vertices and real frequencies. Older equivalent formulations remain a possible originality risk.
title: Parity-dependent Fourier zero strata and sharp odd-dimensional demicube zero radii
